header.title: Badges & Rewards
header.description: Define the achievement badges learners can unlock on the gamified dashboard. Pick what each badge is named, how it looks, and the condition that unlocks it.

enableCard.label: Enable Badges & Leaderboard
enableCard.description: Master switch. When off, badges and the course leaderboard are hidden everywhere — across the learner app and the admin Learning Reports leaderboard tab.

unsavedBanner.text: You have unsaved changes. Don't forget to save.

disabledBanner.after: for this institute. Turn the switch on to configure badges, points and the leaderboard.

scoring.title: Points & Scoring
scoring.description: How many points each action is worth. These drive the learner's points & level and the course leaderboard ranking. Set a factor to 0 to ignore it.

leaderboardNames.title: Show full names on leaderboards
leaderboardNames.description: By default leaderboards show learners as anonymized initials (e.g. "A.G."). Turn this on to show full names on both the shareable public link and the in-app leaderboard learners see. Each learner's own row always reads "You".

libraryArt.title: Show ready-made artwork instead of plain icons
libraryArt.description: Give every badge a polished tiered look, matched to what unlocks it. You can still fine-tune any badge from the library.

emptyState.text: No badges configured. Add one to get started.

iconHint.default: Pick an icon, choose from the library, or upload your own.

badgeCard.descriptionPlaceholder: Shown on hover, e.g. Maintain a 7-day streak
